audit.whatIsWrong: 'Nautilus can't reach you at range' and 'never stand flush against a wall' are right for the wrong reason.
audit.why: Dredge Line (Q, 14/13/12/11/10s, 1150 range) also pulls Nautilus to terrain when it hits a wall, so he can gap-close over a wall without ever touching you. That, not the hook-plus-auto, is why hugging terrain against him is fatal.
audit.corrected: Dredge Line hooks terrain and drags him to it — walls are his approach route, not your cover.

audit.whatIsWrong: Spikes never give the hook or ult cooldowns that define the free windows.
audit.why: Dredge Line is 14s at rank 1 and Depth Charge is 120/100/80s. A missed hook is fourteen seconds of a tank who cannot touch you; a spent Depth Charge is two minutes.
audit.corrected: Bait Dredge Line (14s at rank 1) and free-poke the downtime; a spent Depth Charge (120s) is your all-in window.

audit.whatIsWrong: Staggering Blow is called 'his passive root' and Titan's Wrath and Riptide are unnamed.
audit.why: Staggering Blow roots on his FIRST attack against a given target, so the root is front-loaded on the opener — after it, autos are just autos. Titan's Wrath (W, flat 12s) is a shield whose duration turns his attacks into an AoE damage-over-time, and Riptide (E, 7/6.5/6/5.5/5s) is three slowing waves, which is what actually stops you walking out.
audit.corrected: Staggering Blow roots on his first attack on you only; Titan's Wrath (12s) shields and adds AoE DoT; Riptide's three waves are the slow that holds you.

edits.before: With Heroic Swing online you E off a wall, fire on him while staying outside his hook range, and his AOE and root can't touch you — peak free-poke window once his Dredge Line is on cooldown.
edits.after: With Heroic Swing online you E off a wall, fire on him while staying outside his hook range, and Riptide can't touch you — peak free-poke window while Dredge Line's 14s runs.

edits.before: His one threat window — a 2+ item Nautilus eats your lethality, and a single landed Dredge Line into Depth Charge knockup is a full CC chain that locks and deletes a squishy Akshan.
edits.after: His one threat window — a 2+ item Nautilus eats your lethality, and one Dredge Line into Staggering Blow's root and the Depth Charge knockup is a chain that deletes you.

edits.before: Land Dredge Line to pull you in, proc his passive root on the follow-up auto, and chain into E AOE and the Depth Charge knockup
edits.after: Land Dredge Line to pull you in, proc Staggering Blow's root on his first auto, then Riptide into the Depth Charge knockup

edits.before: Sidestep his Dredge Line hook — without it landing he has no engage and can't start the root-into-Depth-Charge chain that kills you
edits.after: Sidestep Dredge Line — without it landing he has no engage, and remember it also hooks terrain to drag him over walls at you

edits.before: Heroic Swing at 3 lets you swing off a wall and poke from outside hook range — his E AOE and passive root simply can't reach you there.
edits.after: Heroic Swing at 3 lets you swing off a wall and poke from outside hook range — Riptide and Staggering Blow simply can't reach you there.

edits.before: Nautilus can't reach you at range — his entire early game is landing one Dredge Line hook, so sidestep it and the lane is yours. Your Dirty Fighting passive fires a second shot after every auto from level 1, so you already out-trade him every time he walks up to last-hit; just chip with Q and the second shot and respect the level-1 hook into his passive-root proc. Never stand flush against a wall, where a hook plus a follow-up auto pulls you straight into his combo.
edits.after: Nautilus can't reach you at range — his entire early game is landing one Dredge Line, so sidestep it and the lane is yours. Your Dirty Fighting passive fires a second shot after every auto from level 1, so you out-trade him every time he walks up to last-hit; chip with Q and the second shot and respect Staggering Blow, which roots on his first attack on you. Never stand flush against a wall: Dredge Line hooks terrain too and pulls him over it straight into that opener.

notes: 'Dirty Fighting' in the packet's suspectNames is a false positive — it is Akshan's correct passive name.
